_comment: Settings the TrekAhead app reads at startup. Edit, commit, push -- every installed copy picks the change up on its next launch, including old versions. See src/api/remoteConfig.ts.
_brouterUrl: Routing server base URL. MUST be https (iOS blocks plain http) and MUST NOT end in a slash. Anything malformed is ignored and the app keeps its previous value, so a typo degrades rather than breaks. Leave empty until a permanent host exists.
_photoBaseUrl: Where the mirrored hut photos live. The app stores KEYS and joins them to this, so the photos can move without an App Store update -- which they will: Cloudflare documents r2.dev as development-only and rate-limited, and the eventual home is a custom domain. No trailing slash. If this is wrong or missing the app falls back to the original photo URLs, so a typo is slow rather than broken.
_supportEmail: Shown on the About screen. Changing it here changes it in every installed copy, which is the whole reason this file exists.
_notice: A short message shown to users -- e.g. 'Route planning is down for maintenance'. Leave empty for none. Max 280 characters.
